normative_extracts.quote: An animation object samples its effect at each frame according to its current time, playback rate, and easing, independent of script execution once started.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Keyframes targeting transform/opacity/filter serialize to the Compositor Thread; main-thread JS stalls cannot freeze them.

production_failures.symptom: Memory leak and sluggish UI after hundreds of element.animate() calls with fill: "forwards"
production_failures.root_cause: Animations with fill: "forwards" remain active in the engine’s effect stack indefinitely.
production_failures.mitigation: Call animation.commitStyles() then animation.cancel() inside animation.finished, or avoid fill: "forwards".

production_failures.symptom: Animation stutters during React hydration or heavy JSON parsing
production_failures.root_cause: Animating width, top, or background-color forces WAAPI back onto the main thread.
production_failures.mitigation: Restrict keyframes to transform, opacity, filter, and clip-path.
